hooks.command: m=$(jq -r 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | ascii_downcase | endswith(".md")) then empty else [.tool_input.new_string, .tool_input.content, (.tool_input.edits[]?.new_string)] | map(select(. != null)) | .[] end' 2>/dev/null | grep -niE '(^[[:space:]]*[*#]|//).*(used to|previously|formerly|replace[sd]? the old|renamed? (to|from)|no longer|was renamed)'); if [ -n "$m" ]; then jq -n --arg m "$m" '{decision:"block", reason:("A comment in this edit reads like changelog / what-the-code-USED-TO-do narration. CLAUDE.md bans this (do not describe what code used to do; use git history). Remove the historical framing; state only the current contract. Flagged:\n" + $m), systemMessage:"comment-history hook: flagged a changelog-style comment"}'; fi

m=$(jq -r 'if ((.tool_input.file_path // "") | ascii_downcase | endswith(".md")) then empty else [.tool_input.new_string, .tool_input.content, (.tool_input.edits[]?.new_string)] | map(select(. != null)) | .[] end' 2>/dev/null | grep -niE '((^|[^:])//|^[[:space:]]*#)[[:space:]]*((checks? if)|((gets?|sets?|returns?) the)|((loops?|iterates?) (through|over))|((creates?|initializes?) (a|an|the))|((increments?|decrements?) the)|(calls? the)|((adds?|removes?) (a|an|the)))'); if [ -n "$m" ]; then jq -n --arg m "$m" '{decision:"block", reason:("A comment in this edit restates what the code does. CLAUDE.md requires comments to say WHY, not WHAT - identifiers already say what. Delete the comment, or rewrite it to give the reason, constraint, or non-obvious tradeoff. Only inline // and # comments are checked, so ScalaDoc/JSDoc summary lines are exempt. Flagged:\n" + $m), systemMessage:"restate-comment hook: flagged a comment that restates the code"}'; fi
hooks.statusMessage: Checking for comments that restate the code

hooks.command: jq -e '(.tool_input.content // "") as $c | ($c == "" or ($c | endswith("\n")))' >/dev/null 2>&1 || jq -n '{decision:"block", reason:"This Write produced a file with no final newline. docs/style-guide.md requires every file to end with a single trailing newline (a missing one shows as a red marker on the GitHub diff). Re-run Write with a trailing newline added to the content.", systemMessage:"final-newline hook: blocked a Write missing its trailing newline"}'

jq -n '{hookSpecificOutput:{hookEventName:"UserPromptSubmit", additionalContext:"Comment discipline (CLAUDE.md, applies to every edit): write WHY, not WHAT. Before calling an edit done, re-read every comment you added and cut it back - delete ones that restate the code, ones that narrate the change you just made, and doc headers on trivial helpers. One tight line beats three. Keep ScalaDoc/JSDoc on non-trivial functions, but keep the prose minimal."}}'
